notes: Initial representative: 5/5. Full course: Chromium 15/15 and WebKit 15/15, two processes with one worker each. No new course test failure required isolation. The worksheet was four complete pages from its first export; no print refinement was made.

After the initial full runs completed, image alternative text was refined to visible subjects/actions instead of QA language and unprompted outcome statements. Only those strings and their corresponding test assertion changed. Questions, scoring, images and layout remained unchanged. Both engines reran all four story widths, each passing 4/4.

The first grammar item is a two-blank custom input, unlike the previous lesson single choice. Shared retry code was inspected before testing. The test directly checks retained wrong fills after two submissions and reloads, then removal to an incomplete draft, correction and a new round; the product was not changed to fit an inherited expectation.

Chromium account roots each passed all 8 tests using account-before-date-version.json. A subsequent material review added Reporting date:16 October 2026 to a-past so yesterday is anchored inside that question. The record values, answers and scoring are unchanged. All 65 answers and visible materials were rerun on both engines (1 test each); the affected authenticated two-record wrong/reload/partial-fill flow was rerun on both Chromium mounts (1 each). Unchanged Chromium account paths are reused by the recorded scope.

WebKit account mounts ran sequentially on the final account-test-version.json, with one worker and no other browser test runner active. The final two builds overlapped the first WebKit account run. Normal authenticated in-app preview and cover checks occurred during that matrix without answering questions or awarding stars.

Unit/workflow tests and an earlier build overlapped the alternative-text story rerun. No server logic, font bytes or unrelated workflow implementation changed after those checks; the later date addition affects one visible question material and its explicit tests.

Final GIF evidence comes from the final-version WebKit root run. Both 60-frame downloads were checked for stable name/title/scene/paper and changing light effects. Same-name, same-star comparison, mobile and book views are real account outputs. For an unobscured full long-name illustration the gallery uses the Chromium screenshot; the original WebKit element screenshot includes a fixed-header overlap and is retained without relabelling it as a full unobscured capture.
Catalog and deployment checks ran after the account matrix. Representative, alternative-text, date-material and affected account reruns are not added to the 66 distinct successful conditions.

The local demonstration account stayed at 0 stars and word group 1/4. Entry followed the existing account directory after preview restart; viewport overrides were reset. The test student names and rewards in the evidence are independent fictional accounts.
